roe deer noun

also roe, roebuck, roe buck

classical

Hor. C. 3.15.12 (Lewis & Short)
Verg. G. 2.374 (Lewis & Short)
Plin. NH 8.214 (Lewis & Short)

caprea, capreae f.

noun, first declension

a roe deer

From capra: “a kind of wild she-goat, a roe” (Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • capreolus, capreolī m. — a roebuck

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Verg. E. 2.41 (Lewis & Short); Col. 9.1.1 (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. deer: roe

    Lewis & Short: “a kind of wild goat, chamois, roebuck”; the zoologists’ name for the roe deer (Capreolus capreolus).

Examples

  • jungentur capreae lupīs

    roe deer will mate with wolvesHor. C. 1.33.8

See also deer, fawn, chamois, forest.
